meta.description: Counts from Finn-tannlege's one-time Phase A import: one search of Enhetsregisteret (Brønnøysundregistrene) by industry code, and the entries taken from an online directory and merged into it. Counts only, and per organisation number which of two columns (adresse, hjemmeside) only the directory filled: no rows, no names, no values and no contact details.
meta.source: A2A dental-phase-a/dental-merge-report-all.md (input and match counts), dental-phase-a/A1-brreg-summary.csv (industry codes) and PHASE6-DENTAL-VERTICAL.md (run date)
meta.note: The import ran outside this repository (A2A dental-phase-a/merge.py and bulk-insert.py) and stored no source per field. The directory is not named here until Daniel has decided what happens to its data (A2A FUNN dental-katalogimport-valg-hos-daniel). fields_by_org_nr is read once by dental-import-display.ts (F2-S10: those values are not shown on a public surface until an official source confirms them); the rest by dental-sources-truth.test.ts only. No route serves this file.

fields_by_org_nr.description: fields_by_org_nr: for each organisation number, the columns whose stored value came from the directory only (the Enhetsregisteret search had none). Organisation numbers and column names only. Generated in A2A by re-running the merge; counts and the sha256 of its inputs below.
